experiments.experiment_label: In vivo gene editing of FVIII in HemA mice using Cas9 mRNA LNPs
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: To target a five base pair deletion in FVIII exon 1 in a specific HemA mouse strain, we injected LNPs encapsulating Cas9 mRNA and specifically designed sgRNAs intravenously for in vivo gene editing of the mutant FVIII.
experiments.payload_or_treatment_mention: Cas9 mRNA and specifically designed sgRNAs
experiments.distinctness_reason: Only one experiment is described with consistent payload, model, delivery system, route, and timepoints; no material differences in treatment/payload, biological model, disease context, recipient population, dose, route, or timepoint are reported.
